acceptance: No session, application or cluster is created or restarted after run-timeout cleanup, proven by a race test per affected adapter, or the item is dropped with evidence.
context: Filed 2026-11-25 at the close of the run-timeout effort (umbrella run-timeout-plan-20261120, done). Evidence read that day; re-read code, docs and run folders before acting.
description:
## Problem
Run-timeout cleanup runs on the daemon thread `benchbox-remote-cleanup` (`start_remote_cleanup` in `benchbox/utils/run_deadline.py`) while the main thread keeps going, so a statement still running can re-create what cleanup removed (reported unverified by the implementer of #4507; not reproduced):
- Fabric Spark, Synapse Spark: `LivyStatementMixin.cancel_remote_work` deletes the run-created Livy session and sets `_session_id = None`; the next `_ensure_session` then calls `_create_session`, and nothing deletes the new session.
- Dataproc: cleanup deletes the run-created ephemeral cluster, and `execute_query` calls `_ensure_cluster_exists()` per query, which re-creates the cluster on NotFound when `create_ephemeral_cluster` is set (the most expensive case).
- EMR Serverless: cleanup stops the application and clears `_application_created_by_us`; `_ensure_application_started` then restarts it, and because the flag is cleared `close()` no longer stops it.
Athena Spark was checked and is not affected: after terminate, submission raises `ConfigurationError`.

## Change
Write stubbed race tests that run a statement on one thread, trigger cleanup from another, and check whether a session, cluster or application is created or restarted afterwards. Where it is, stop the adapter from re-creating or restarting run resources once cleanup has run for this run (for example a cleaned-up flag checked before create/start that raises the run timeout), the same way in every affected adapter.

## Decision gates
- If the test shows no new session can be created, record the evidence and drop the item (owner decision).
- Do not add a deadline check inside a query timer; no new default timeout.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the race test fails before and passes after for Fabric Spark, Synapse Spark, EMR Serverless and Dataproc (or recorded evidence that it cannot happen); existing run-timeout cleanup tests pass.
Fail: a fix without a test that reproduces the race.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
